import numpy as np


def forecast(train_series, history_windows, feature_cols, target_col, input_len, output_len):
    t_idx = feature_cols.index(target_col)
    # Use training data mean as a long-term anchor
    train_mean = train_series[target_col].mean()
    w_idx = feature_cols.index("Wspd")
    bins = np.percentile(train_series["Wspd"], np.linspace(0, 100, 20))
    w_bin = np.digitize(history_windows[:, -1, w_idx], bins)
    bin_means = train_series.groupby(np.digitize(train_series["Wspd"], bins))[target_col].mean()
    a_w = np.array([bin_means.get(b, train_mean) for b in w_bin])
    
    daily = train_series.groupby(np.arange(len(train_series)) % 144)[target_col].mean().values
    a_d = np.tile(daily, (output_len // 144) + 1)[:output_len]
    anchor = (a_w[:, None] * 0.5) + (a_d[None, :] * 0.5)
    
    last_p = history_windows[:, -1, t_idx]
    trend = last_p - history_windows[:, -36:, t_idx].mean(axis=1)
    decay = np.exp(-np.linspace(0, 3.5, output_len))
